text_block_list.text:
Said that Uma Musume destined for top possess 
immense ambition and aura captivating all.
"She" possessed that aura.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha, ha, ha…!

Lean frame cutting wind, long legs striking ground lightly. 
Splendid yet commanding gaze fixed ahead, unyielding.

Aura of dignity and fortitude radiating from whole body, 
commanding deference fit for "Empress"―

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph…

…Before long, time slipped by, 
evening sky dyed crimson.

Then, horse girl approached Air Groove 
as she concluded training―

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Sorry to keep you waiting. 
Got carried away running outside…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph… same as ever, Suzuka. 
Anticipated as much, so no matter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Regardless, do you retain stamina to race?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, no issue. Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove and Suzuka racing now? 
Looks like good show coming up!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Match between two top talents! 
Much to glean from this.

Crowd formed around track instantly. 
Under watchful eyes, duo surged forward together.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha, ha…!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ohh…! 
Suzuka's breakaway pace never fails to astound.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove won't let it end like this either. 
Look… gap seems to fire her up even more!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Hm.

Then, as Silence Suzuka rounded 
final bend with commanding lead―!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ―Haa!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! 
Oi oi, closed that gap instantly…!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Incredible finishing burst…! Judgment on when to chase 
was flawless. Suzuka cannot bridge this…!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Kh…!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This race… is mine!

Fierce fighting spirit paired with cold precision. 
Overwhelming running prowess… absolute excellence across board.

Maintaining lead over Silence Suzuka, 
Air Groove crossed finish line…
Stood stunned as roar of spectators echoed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Man, incredible spectacle! 
Wanna challenge her one-on-one next.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Runner of her caliber 
displays form worthy of ideal standard…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, as student council vice president, 
she sustains daily academy operations admirably.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe 'sustains' is stretch, but… 
fair enough, she bails folks out often.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood why juniors revere her. 
I too aspire to such standard.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
…Hey, you. 
Been staring at Air Groove while now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you. Who else? Unfamiliar face. 
New trainer around here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you intend to scout Air Groove?
choice_data_list: If it's possible I'd love to…!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, well… missed your chance there.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Here you were. 
Self-training again today…?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed… is there problem?

text_block_list.name: Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
…No. Regarding tomorrow, mind if we adjust schedule? 
Need to push start back 30 minutes for matters.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…Hmph. Track already booked, correct? 
Then I shall execute training regimen independently.

text_block_list.name: Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Eh? Wouldn't resting be wiser ch―

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Debut race approaches. 
I have zero time to squander.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I manage rest without reminders. 
Has reason existed for you to alter plans until now?

text_block_list.name: Groove's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-Well… no. 
…Understood. Proceed without me then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, dragging trainer by collar as usual! 
…Well, you see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunate news for you, but… 
Air Groove already has trainer assigned.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Skipped Selection Race, so fair enough. 
Still, no rule forbids prior scouting.

Other trainers had clearly recognized 
Air Groove's exceptional talent…
Departed track that day with deep regret.
